import hashlib
from collections import defaultdict

A, B = Checkpoint("A"), Checkpoint("B")

def file_hash(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def squared_norm(x):
    return float(np.einsum("i,i->", x.ravel(), x.ravel(),
                           dtype=np.float64, optimize=False))

print("=== ARCHITECTURE ===")
print(json.dumps(A.config, indent=2))
print("Configs identical:", A.config == B.config)
if A.config != B.config:
    print("B config:", json.dumps(B.config, indent=2))

print("\n=== FILE AND TENSOR CONSISTENCY ===")
for filename in ("tokenizer.json", "tokenizer_config.json"):
    print(filename, "identical:",
          file_hash(f"/case/A/{filename}") ==
          file_hash(f"/case/B/{filename}"))

ka, kb = set(A.keys()), set(B.keys())
print("Tensor names identical:", ka == kb)
print("Only A:", sorted(ka - kb))
print("Only B:", sorted(kb - ka))
print("Stored parameters A:",
      sum(int(np.prod(A.shape(k))) for k in ka))
print("Tensor count:", len(ka))

print("\n=== REPRESENTATIVE TENSOR SHAPES ===")
for name in A.keys():
    match = re.search(r"(?:^|\.)layers\.(\d+)\.", name)
    if match is None or int(match.group(1)) == 0:
        print(name, A.shape(name), A.info[name]["dtype"])

records = []
unchanged = []
groups = defaultdict(lambda: [0.0, 0.0, 0, 0])

for name in sorted(ka & kb):
    if A.shape(name) != B.shape(name):
        print("SHAPE MISMATCH:", name, A.shape(name), B.shape(name))
        continue

    a, b = A.get(name), B.get(name)
    is_embedding = "embed_tokens" in name or "embedding" in name
    if is_embedding:
        same = np.array_equal(a, b)
        print("\nEmbedding:", name, "exactly identical:", same)
        if same:
            unchanged.append(name)
            del a, b
            continue

    d = b - a
    changed = int(np.count_nonzero(d))
    if changed == 0:
        unchanged.append(name)
        del a, b, d
        continue

    mid = (a + b) * np.float32(0.5)
    d2, m2 = squared_norm(d), squared_norm(mid)
    size = a.size
    match = re.search(r"(?:^|\.)layers\.(\d+)\.", name)
    layer = int(match.group(1)) if match else -1

    if ".self_attn." in name:
        part = "attention"
    elif ".mlp." in name:
        part = "mlp"
    else:
        part = "norm/other"

    record = dict(
        name=name, layer=layer, part=part, size=size,
        d2=d2, m2=m2, changed=changed,
        relative=np.sqrt(d2 / max(m2, 1e-300)),
    )
    records.append(record)
    group = groups[(layer, part)]
    group[0] += d2
    group[1] += m2
    group[2] += size
    group[3] += changed
    del a, b, d, mid

print("\n=== DIFFERENCE INVENTORY: B MINUS A ===")
print("These are descriptive magnitudes, NOT behavioural importance scores.")
total_d2 = sum(r["d2"] for r in records)
print("Total squared parameter difference:", total_d2)
print("Exactly unchanged tensors:", len(unchanged))
for name in unchanged[:35]:
    print("  ", name)
if len(unchanged) > 35:
    print("  ...", len(unchanged) - 35, "more")

print("\n=== PER-LAYER / COMPONENT SUMMARY ===")
print("layer part          delta_F    relative_F   changed_fraction  share_delta_squared")
for (layer, part), (d2, m2, size, changed) in sorted(groups.items()):
    print(f"{layer:5d} {part:12s} {np.sqrt(d2):10.5f} "
          f"{np.sqrt(d2 / max(m2, 1e-300)):12.6f} "
          f"{changed / size:17.6f} "
          f"{d2 / max(total_d2, 1e-300):19.6f}")

print("\n=== TOP 25 TENSORS BY ABSOLUTE DIFFERENCE ===")
for r in sorted(records, key=lambda r: r["d2"], reverse=True)[:25]:
    print(f"{r['name']:65s} "
          f"delta_F={np.sqrt(r['d2']):9.5f} "
          f"rel={r['relative']:.6f} "
          f"changed={r['changed']/r['size']:.4f}")

print("\n=== TOP 20 TENSORS BY RELATIVE DIFFERENCE ===")
for r in sorted(records, key=lambda r: r["relative"], reverse=True)[:20]:
    print(f"{r['name']:65s} "
          f"rel={r['relative']:.6f} "
          f"delta_F={np.sqrt(r['d2']):9.5f}")

print("\n=== NORMALIZATION WEIGHT RANGES ===")
for name in A.keys():
    if name not in kb or "norm" not in name or len(A.shape(name)) != 1:
        continue
    a, b = A.get(name), B.get(name)
    print(f"{name:65s} "
          f"A[min,mean,max]=[{a.min():.4f},{a.mean():.4f},{a.max():.4f}] "
          f"B=[{b.min():.4f},{b.mean():.4f},{b.max():.4f}]")

def spectral_summary(D):
    C = D @ D.T
    vals, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(C)
    order = np.argsort(vals)[::-1]
    vals = np.maximum(vals[order], 0)
    vecs = vecs[:, order]
    total = float(vals.sum())
    shares = [float(vals[:k].sum() / max(total, 1e-30))
              for k in (1, 4, 16)]
    # Fix sign for reproducibility, not as a behavioural interpretation.
    v = vecs[:, 0].copy()
    if v[np.argmax(np.abs(v))] < 0:
        v *= -1
    return total, shares, v, C

def token_extremes(scores, k=5):
    hi = np.argpartition(scores, -k)[-k:]
    lo = np.argpartition(scores, k)[:k]
    hi = hi[np.argsort(scores[hi])[::-1]]
    lo = lo[np.argsort(scores[lo])]
    return (
        [(tok.text(int(i)), round(float(scores[i]), 4)) for i in hi],
        [(tok.text(int(i)), round(float(scores[i]), 4)) for i in lo],
    )

def metrics(M, denominator):
    # Numerical double-centering; the source weights were already centered.
    M = M - M.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    M = M - M.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    # Exact null SD of trace under uniformly permuted token correspondences.

    z = tr * np.sqrt(len(M) - 1) / max(fro, 1e-30)
    return tr / max(denominator, 1e-30), z

def unit_trace(C):
    return C / max(float(np.trace(C)), 1e-30)

def analyse(C):
    vals, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(C)
    order = np.argsort(vals)[::-1]
    vals, vecs = np.maximum(vals[order], 0), vecs[:, order]
    tr = float(vals.sum())
    top = vals[:3] / max(tr, 1e-30)
    effective_rank = tr * tr / max(float(np.sum(vals * vals)), 1e-30)
    digit_fraction = float(np.trace(Qd.T @ C @ Qd)) / max(tr, 1e-30)
    number_fraction = float(number_direction @ C @ number_direction) / max(tr, 1e-30)
    # Large ratio requires correlated residual coordinates, not only one
    # high-variance coordinate.
    coherence = float(vals[0]) / max(float(np.max(np.diag(C))), 1e-30)
    return dict(top=top, erank=effective_rank, digit=digit_fraction,
                number=number_fraction, coherence=coherence,
                vectors=vecs[:, :2])

    else:
        ids = allowed
    s = scores[ids]

def path_stats(L, R, denom):
    # L = embedding-weight contractions with down matrix.
    # R = embedding-weight contractions with up OR gate matrix.
    # No gate, activation, or state normalization is evaluated.
    M = L @ R.T
    M -= M.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    M -= M.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    unit = np.sum(L * R, axis=0) / denom
    return M, unit

def rowdot(x, y):
    return np.einsum("ij,ij->i", x, y)

def coefficient_change(da, db, ga, gb, ua, ub):
    # Inputs have one unit per row.
    # Inner products of d ⊗ sym(g ⊗ u), without materializing tensors.
    na = rowdot(da, da) * .5 * (
        rowdot(ga, ga) * rowdot(ua, ua) + rowdot(ga, ua)**2)
    nb = rowdot(db, db) * .5 * (
        rowdot(gb, gb) * rowdot(ub, ub) + rowdot(gb, ub)**2)
    cross = rowdot(da, db) * .5 * (
        rowdot(ga, gb)*rowdot(ua, ub) +
        rowdot(ga, ub)*rowdot(ua, gb))
    return np.maximum(na + nb - 2*cross, 0), (na + nb)*.5

def basis_from_rows(X, remove=None):
    X = X.astype(np.float64)
    X -= X.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    if remove is not None:
        X -= (X @ remove) @ remove.T
    _, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False)
    return vt[s > s[0]*1e-6].T.astype(np.float32)

def rotate_weight_rows(K, distance, theta):
    # Relative-position linear operator R(-distance) on WEIGHT rows.
    # No token positions or sequence are instantiated.
    freq = theta ** (-np.arange(0,256,2,dtype=np.float64)/256)
    ang = -distance * freq
    c, s = np.cos(ang)[:,None], np.sin(ang)[:,None]
    x, y = K[:128], K[128:]
    return np.concatenate([c*x-s*y, s*x+c*y],axis=0)

def weights(cp, layer, head, mode):
    p = f"model.layers.{layer}."
    Q = cp.get(p+"self_attn.q_proj.weight").reshape(4,256,640)[head].astype(np.float64)
    K = cp.get(p+"self_attn.k_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    if mode == "diag":
        inp = 1+cp.get(p+"input_layernorm.weight")
        Q *= (1+cp.get(p+"self_attn.q_norm.weight"))[:,None]*inp[None,:]
        K *= (1+cp.get(p+"self_attn.k_norm.weight"))[:,None]*inp[None,:]
    return Q,K

def matrix_change(Oa,Va,Ob,Vb,source,output,subset=None):
    if subset is None:

    Zo=centered(X[output][subset])
    norm=np.sqrt(np.sum(Zi*Zi)*np.sum(Zo*Zo))
    Ma=(Zo@Oa)@(Zi@Va.T).T
    Mb=(Zo@Ob)@(Zi@Vb.T).T
    return (Mb-Ma)/max(float(norm),1e-30)

def rotate(K,d):
    f=10000.0**(-np.arange(0,256,2,dtype=np.float64)/256)
    c=np.cos(-d*f)
    s=np.sin(-d*f)
    if K.ndim==2:
        c=c[:,None]; s=s[:,None]
    return np.concatenate((c*K[:128]-s*K[128:],
                           s*K[:128]+c*K[128:]),axis=0)

def get_qk(cp,h,mode):
    p="model.layers.1."
    Q=cp.get(p+"self_attn.q_proj.weight").reshape(4,256,640)[h].astype(np.float64)

        K*=((1+cp.get(p+"self_attn.k_norm.weight"))[:,None]*inp)
    return Q,K

_,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(Zd,full_matrices=False)
Qd=vt[s>s[0]*1e-6].T

def rd(x,y):
    return np.einsum("ij,ij->i",x,y)

def tensor_inner(P,R):
    d,g,u=P; e,h,v=R
    return rd(d,e)*.5*(rd(g,h)*rd(u,v)+rd(g,v)*rd(u,h))

def load_parts(l,scaled=False):
    p=f"model.layers.{l}."
    ga=A.get(p+"mlp.gate_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    gb=B.get(p+"mlp.gate_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ua=A.get(p+"mlp.up_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ub=B.get(p+"mlp.up_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    da=A.get(p+"mlp.down_proj.weight").T.astype(np.float64)
    db=B.get(p+"mlp.down_proj.weight").T.astype(np.float64)
    if scaled:
        ia=1+A.get(p+"pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
        ib=1+B.get(p+"pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
        oa=(1+A.get(p+"post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"))*(1+A.get("model.norm.weight"))
        ob=(1+B.get(p+"post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"))*(1+B.get("model.norm.weight"))
        ga*=ia; ua*=ia; gb*=ib; ub*=ib
        da*=oa; db*=ob
    da=da@Qd; db=db@Qd
    dm,gm,um=(da+db)*.5,(ga+gb)*.5,(ua+ub)*.5
    dd,dg,du=db-da,gb-ga,ub-ua
    # Exact symmetric midpoint expansion of the trilinear coefficient:
    # Delta(d*g*u) = dd*gm*um + dm*dg*um + dm*gm*du + dd*dg*du/4.
    return [(dd,gm,um),(dm,dg,um),(dm,gm,du),(.25*dd,dg,du)]

def unit_attribution(parts):
    gram=np.empty((4,4,2048),np.float64)
    for i in range(4):
        for j in range(i,4):
            gram[i,j]=gram[j,i]=tensor_inner(parts[i],parts[j])
    unit=np.maximum(gram.sum(axis=(0,1)),0)
    total=max(float(unit.sum()),1e-30)
    shares=gram.sum(axis=(1,2))/total
    return unit,shares

def describe(v):
    profile=Zd@v
    n=float(np.linalg.norm(profile))
    if n<1e-30:
        return "none",0.0,0.0
    p=profile/n
    label,cos=max(((label,float(p@t)) for label,t in templates.items()),
                  key=lambda pair:abs(pair[1]))
    fraction=float(np.sum((Qd.T@v)**2)/max(float(v@v),1e-30))
    return label,cos,fraction

final_a=1+A.get("model.norm.weight")
final_b=1+B.get("model.norm.weight")

def numerical_profiles(W):
    # One unit per row; these are weight-vector coordinates.
    P=W@Zd.T
    norms=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(P,axis=1),1e-30)
    # Cosine to each centered one-hot digit template in profile space.
    cos=P/(norms[:,None]*np.sqrt(.9))
    frac=np.sum((W@Qd)**2,axis=1)/np.maximum(np.sum(W*W,axis=1),1e-30)
    return cos,frac

    gc,gf=numerical_profiles(gm)

def basis(words):
    ids=[]
    for w in words:
        ii=tok.encode(w)
        if len(ii)==1 and ii[0] not in ids: ids.append(ii[0])
    X=E[ids].astype(np.float64)
    _,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(X,full_matrices=False)
    return vt[s>s[0]*1e-7].T

SQbelief=basis([" think","think"," believe"," guess"," suppose"," reckon",
                " assume"," know"," say"," want"," need"," have"," see"])
SKbelief=basis([" I","I"," my"," me"," you"," he"," she"," we"," they"])
SQoperator=basis([" plus","plus"," PLUS"," minus","minus"," Minus"," times",
                  "times","+","-","*"," know"," say"," want"," need"])
SKoperator=basis(list("0123456789")+list("ABCDEFGHIJ"))

def global_radial(D,M):
    alpha=float(np.sum(D*M)/max(np.sum(M*M),1e-30))
    residual=D-alpha*M
    retained=float(np.sum(residual*residual)/max(np.sum(D*D),1e-30))
    return alpha,retained,residual

def gram_gain_bounds(Wa,Wb,S):
    # Generalized eigenvalues of WEIGHT Gram matrices restricted to a subspace.
    # No Q/K vector for a token is normalized; no attention score is formed.
    X=Wa@S; Y=Wb@S
    Ga=X.T@X; Gb=Y.T@Y
    ev,U=np.linalg.eigh(Ga)
    keep=ev>ev.max()*1e-10
    whitening=U[:,keep]/np.sqrt(ev[keep])[None,:]
    C=whitening.T@Gb@whitening
    vals=np.maximum(np.linalg.eigvalsh(C),0)
    return np.sqrt(vals.min()),np.sqrt(vals.max()),int(keep.sum())

    qb=B.get(p+"self_attn.q_proj.weight").reshape(4,256,640)[h].astype(np.float64)

    for name,wa,wb in [("Q",qa,qb),("shared K",ka,kb)]:
        alpha,retained,_=global_radial(wb-wa,(wa+wb)*.5)
        print(name,"global radial coefficient",alpha,

    print("Q norm-gain bounds from weight Grams:",
          gram_gain_bounds(qa*inp,qb*inp,SQ))
    print("K norm-gain bounds from weight Grams:",
          gram_gain_bounds(ka*inp,kb*inp,SK))

    column_alpha=np.sum(D*M,axis=0)/np.maximum(np.sum(M*M,axis=0),1e-30)
    column_residual=D-M*column_alpha[None,:]
    numeric_columns=float(np.sum((Qd.T@column_residual)**2))/max(numeric,1e-30)

    before=float(np.sum(Dd*Dd)+np.sum(Du*Du))
    after=float(np.sum((Dd-scale[:,None]*Dm)**2)+
                np.sum((Du+scale[:,None]*Um)**2))

          float(1-after/max(before,1e-30)))

A, B, tok = Checkpoint("A"), Checkpoint("B"), Tokenizer()
E = A.get("model.embed_tokens.weight")
ids = [tok.encode(s)[0] for s in "0123456789"]

Zd = E[ids].astype(np.float64)
Zd -= Zd.mean(axis=0)
_, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(Zd, full_matrices=False)
Qd = vt[s > s[0]*1e-6].T

Z = E[ids].astype(np.float64)
Z /= np.linalg.norm(Z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
Z -= Z.mean(axis=0)
denom = float(np.sum(Z*Z))
del E

final_a = 1 + A.get("model.norm.weight")
final_b = 1 + B.get("model.norm.weight")

# Unique head-sign patterns, modulo changing all four signs together.
signs = np.array([
    [1, a, b, c]
    for a in (-1, 1)
    for b in (-1, 1)
    for c in (-1, 1)
], dtype=np.float64)

def head_geometry(P):
    # P: head x numerical-output-coordinate x residual-input-coordinate.
    F = P.reshape(4, -1)
    G = F @ F.T
    energy = max(float(np.trace(G)), 1e-30)
    common_fraction = float(G.sum()) / (4*energy)
    norm = np.sqrt(np.maximum(np.diag(G), 1e-30))
    correlations = G / (norm[:, None]*norm[None, :])
    sign_control = np.einsum("si,ij,sj->s", signs, G, signs)/(4*energy)
    return energy, common_fraction, correlations, sign_control

records = []
print("=== NEW HYPOTHESIS: HEAD REDISTRIBUTION / CANCELLATION ===")
print("All heads in a layer share V; each has its own O slice.")
print("Numerical kernel: P_h = Qdigit^T (O_h V).")
print("Head-common mode = (P_0 + P_1 + P_2 + P_3)/2.")
print("Common-mode fraction is 0 for exact cancellation, .25 for uncorrelated")
print("equal-energy changes, and 1 for identical changes across heads.")
print("None of these operators includes attention weights or a model input.")

for l in range(18):
    p = f"model.layers.{l}."
    va = A.get(p+"self_attn.v_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    vb = B.get(p+"self_attn.v_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    oa = A.get(p+"self_attn.o_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ob = B.get(p+"self_attn.o_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ia = 1 + A.get(p+"input_layernorm.weight")
    ib = 1 + B.get(p+"input_layernorm.weight")
    pa = final_a*(1 + A.get(p+"post_attention_layernorm.weight"))
    pb = final_b*(1 + B.get(p+"post_attention_layernorm.weight"))

    for mode in ("raw", "diag"):
        Ra = va if mode == "raw" else va*ia[None, :]
        Rb = vb if mode == "raw" else vb*ib[None, :]
        Rm, dR = (Ra+Rb)*.5, Rb-Ra
        totals, midpoints, oparts, vparts, copy = [], [], [], [], []

        for h in range(4):
            sl = slice(h*256, (h+1)*256)
            La, Lb = oa[:, sl], ob[:, sl]
            if mode == "diag":
                La, Lb = pa[:, None]*La, pb[:, None]*Lb
            Lm, dL = (La+Lb)*.5, Lb-La

            # Exact midpoint product decomposition, all on weights:
            # Delta(O V) = DeltaO Vmid + Omid DeltaV.
            po = (Qd.T @ dL) @ Rm
            pv = (Qd.T @ Lm) @ dR
            pm = .5*((Qd.T @ La) @ Ra + (Qd.T @ Lb) @ Rb)
            totals.append(po+pv)
            midpoints.append(pm)
            oparts.append(po)
            vparts.append(pv)

            # Independent identity-alignment statistic for each head.
            ca = float(np.sum((Z@La)*(Z@Ra.T))/denom)
            cb = float(np.sum((Z@Lb)*(Z@Rb.T))/denom)
            copy.append(cb-ca)

        P = np.stack(totals)
        M = np.stack(midpoints)
        PO, PV = np.stack(oparts), np.stack(vparts)
        energy, common, corr, controls = head_geometry(P)
        _, base_common, _, _ = head_geometry(M)

        # Signed additive attribution of the stacked numerical kernel change.
        oshare = float(np.sum(PO*P))/energy
        vshare = float(np.sum(PV*P))/energy
        copy = np.array(copy)
        cancellation = 1-abs(float(copy.sum()))/max(float(np.abs(copy).sum()),1e-30)

        records.append(dict(
            layer=l, mode=mode, energy=energy, common=common,
            base_common=base_common, corr=corr, controls=controls,
            oshare=oshare, vshare=vshare, copy=copy,
            cancellation=cancellation,
            common_o=float(np.sum(PO.sum(axis=0)*P.sum(axis=0))),
            common_v=float(np.sum(PV.sum(axis=0)*P.sum(axis=0))),
        ))

print("\n=== ALL-LAYER COMMON-MODE AND SHARED-VALUE SUMMARY ===")

for r in records:

    print("Output-slice / shared-value attribution:",

    print("Actual common-mode fraction:", round(r["common"], 5))
    print("Common-mode fractions under head-sign controls:",
          np.round(np.sort(r["controls"]), 5))
    total = r["common_o"]+r["common_v"]
    if abs(total) > 1e-30:

              round(r["common_o"]/total, 5),
              round(r["common_v"]/total, 5))

A, B, tok = Checkpoint("A"), Checkpoint("B"), Tokenizer()
E = A.get("model.embed_tokens.weight")
ids = [tok.encode(s)[0] for s in "0123456789"]
Z = E[ids].astype(np.float64)
Z /= np.linalg.norm(Z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
Z -= Z.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
denom = float(np.sum(Z*Z))
del E

# Fixed orthogonal contrasts over the TEN TOKEN LABELS.
# These are not hidden states or model inputs.
digits = np.arange(10, dtype=np.float64)
seeds = [
    np.ones(10),
    digits,
    (digits-4.5)**2,
    np.array([1 if d % 2 == 0 else -1 for d in range(10)], dtype=float),
] + [np.eye(10)[i] for i in range(10)]

basis = []
for seed in seeds:
    v = seed.copy()
    for q in basis:
        v -= q * float(q @ v)
    # Reorthogonalize for numerical stability.
    for q in basis:
        v -= q * float(q @ v)
    n = float(np.linalg.norm(v))
    if n > 1e-10:
        basis.append(v/n)
    if len(basis) == 10:
        break

H = np.stack(basis[1:], axis=1)  # Exclude constant contrast.
assert H.shape == (10, 9)
print("=== NEW HYPOTHESIS: LOW-ORDER NUMERICAL RECALIBRATION ===")
print("Contrast columns: linear magnitude, quadratic magnitude, orthogonalized parity,")
print("then six remaining independent digit distinctions.")
print("No questions, answers, hidden states, or nonlinear responses are supplied.")
print("First three contrast vectors, digit order 0..9:")
print(np.round(H[:, :3].T, 4))
print("Orthogonality error:", np.max(np.abs(H.T@H-np.eye(9))))

final_a = 1 + A.get("model.norm.weight")
final_b = 1 + B.get("model.norm.weight")

def contrast_energy(C):
    # C is a token-readout coefficient matrix, not a model output.
    F = H.T @ C
    total = max(float(np.sum(F*F)), 1e-30)
    return np.array([
        np.sum(F[0]*F[0]),
        np.sum(F[1]*F[1]),
        np.sum(F[2]*F[2]),
        np.sum(F[3:]*F[3:]),
    ], dtype=float) / total

print("\n=== MLP OUTPUT-WEIGHT DIFFERENCES: MAGNITUDE/PARITY VERSUS REMAINING DIGITS ===")
print("Fractions sum to one within numerical token-readout coefficient space.")
print("Midpoint comparison is A/B midpoint, NOT the unavailable starting model.")
print(" L mode   delta_linear delta_quadratic delta_parity delta_remaining"
      "   midpoint_low3")

for l in range(18):
    p = f"model.layers.{l}."
    da = A.get(p+"mlp.down_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    db = B.get(p+"mlp.down_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    pa = final_a*(1+A.get(p+"post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"))
    pb = final_b*(1+B.get(p+"post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"))
    for mode in ("raw", "diag"):
        wa = da if mode == "raw" else pa[:, None]*da
        wb = db if mode == "raw" else pb[:, None]*db
        changed = Z @ (wb-wa)
        midpoint = Z @ ((wa+wb)*.5)
        shares = contrast_energy(changed)
        mid = contrast_energy(midpoint)
        print(f"{l:2d} {mode:4s} "
              + " ".join(f"{v:14.5f}" for v in shares)
              + f" {mid[:3].sum():15.5f}")

def ov_weights(cp, l, h, mode):
    p = f"model.layers.{l}."
    O = cp.get(p+"self_attn.o_proj.weight")[:, h*256:(h+1)*256].astype(np.float64)
    V = cp.get(p+"self_attn.v_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    if mode == "diag":
        O *= ((1+cp.get(p+"post_attention_layernorm.weight")) *
              (1+cp.get("model.norm.weight")))[:, None]
        V *= 1+cp.get(p+"input_layernorm.weight")
    return O, V

print("\n=== OV IDENTITY CHANGE AFTER REMOVING LOW-ORDER NUMERICAL CONTRASTS ===")
print("All signed coefficients are B-A.")
print("The first three diagonal terms plus residual trace equal the original identity trace.")
print("Residual identity is restricted to six remaining digit distinctions.")
print(" L H mode      total_identity       linear       quadratic       parity"
      "     residual_identity   residual_block_energy")

records = []
for l in (1, 15, 16, 17):
    for mode in ("raw", "diag"):
        block = np.zeros((9, 9), dtype=np.float64)
        for h in range(4):
            Oa, Va = ov_weights(A, l, h, mode)
            Ob, Vb = ov_weights(B, l, h, mode)
            Ma = (Z@Oa) @ (Z@Va.T).T
            Mb = (Z@Ob) @ (Z@Vb.T).T
            D = (Mb-Ma)/denom
            C = H.T @ D @ H
            block += C
            diagonal = np.diag(C)
            total = float(np.trace(C))
            residual = float(np.trace(C[3:, 3:]))
            remaining_energy = float(np.sum(C[3:, 3:]**2)) / max(
                float(np.sum(C*C)), 1e-30)
            records.append((l, h, mode, total, residual, remaining_energy))
            print(f"{l:2d} {h} {mode:4s} {total:+18.7g} "
                  f"{diagonal[0]:+13.6g} {diagonal[1]:+13.6g} "
                  f"{diagonal[2]:+13.6g} {residual:+21.7g} "
                  f"{remaining_energy:23.5f}")

        print(f"  BLOCK SUM L{l} {mode}: original={np.trace(block):+.7g}, "
              f"low3={np.trace(block[:3,:3]):+.7g}, "
              f"remaining={np.trace(block[3:,3:]):+.7g}")
        print("  This block sum is an operator comparison, not actual summed head output.")

print("\n=== PREVIOUS COPYING CANDIDATES: SIGN RETENTION ===")
for key in [(1,0), (1,1), (15,3), (16,2), (17,0), (17,1)]:

A, B, tok = Checkpoint("A"), Checkpoint("B"), Tokenizer()
E = A.get("model.embed_tokens.weight")

specs = {
    "digits": list("0123456789"),
    "letters": list("ABCDEFGHIJ"),
    "nouns": [" cat", " dog", " bird", " fish", " tree",
              " house", " car", " book", " water", " food"],
}
subspaces = {}
print("=== NEW HYPOTHESIS: NUMERICAL RECENCY BIAS ===")
print("No sequence, attention distribution, or normalized Q/K state is evaluated.")
print("Each statistic contracts a relative-position WEIGHT kernel with a")
print("fixed token-weight covariance of unit trace.")

for label, words in specs.items():
    ids = []
    kept = []
    for word in words:
        ii = tok.encode(word)
        if len(ii) == 1 and tok.text(ii[0]) == word:
            ids.append(ii[0])
            kept.append(word)
    X = E[ids].astype(np.float64)
    X /= np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    X -= X.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
    subspaces[label] = X.T / max(float(np.linalg.norm(X)), 1e-30)
    print(label, kept)

# A separate number-category direction distinguishes numerical category
# from distinctions among individual digits.
digit_ids = [tok.encode(s)[0] for s in "0123456789"]
category = E[digit_ids].mean(axis=0).astype(np.float64)
category -= E.mean(axis=0)
category /= np.linalg.norm(category)
subspaces["number_category"] = category[:, None]
del E

distances = np.arange(1, 513, dtype=np.float64)
windows = [
    ("near1_4_far17_32", 1, 4, 17, 32),
    ("near1_8_far65_128", 1, 8, 65, 128),
    ("near1_16_far129_256", 1, 16, 129, 256),
]

def fourier_coefficients(Q, K, S):
    # tr(S^T Q^T R(-d) K S)
    # = sum_i a_i cos(d*w_i) + b_i sin(d*w_i).
    # All quantities here are weight-matrix contractions.
    Qs, Ks = Q @ S, K @ S
    qx, qy = Qs[:128], Qs[128:]
    kx, ky = Ks[:128], Ks[128:]
    a = np.sum(qx*kx + qy*ky, axis=1)
    b = np.sum(qx*ky - qy*kx, axis=1)
    return a, b

def window_contrast(curve, window):
    _, na, nb, fa, fb = window
    near = curve[na-1:nb].mean()
    far = curve[fa-1:fb].mean()
    return float(near-far)

records = []
for l in range(18):
    p = f"model.layers.{l}."
    qa = A.get(p+"self_attn.q_proj.weight").reshape(4,256,640).astype(np.float64)
    qb = B.get(p+"self_attn.q_proj.weight").reshape(4,256,640).astype(np.float64)
    ka = A.get(p+"self_attn.k_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    kb = B.get(p+"self_attn.k_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ia = 1+A.get(p+"input_layernorm.weight")
    ib = 1+B.get(p+"input_layernorm.weight")
    qna = 1+A.get(p+"self_attn.q_norm.weight")
    qnb = 1+B.get(p+"self_attn.q_norm.weight")
    kna = 1+A.get(p+"self_attn.k_norm.weight")
    knb = 1+B.get(p+"self_attn.k_norm.weight")

    kind = A.config["layer_types"][l]
    theta = A.config["rope_parameters"][kind]["rope_theta"]
    freq = theta**(-np.arange(0,256,2,dtype=np.float64)/256)
    cosine = np.cos(distances[:,None]*freq[None,:])
    sine = np.sin(distances[:,None]*freq[None,:])
    periods = 2*np.pi/freq

    for h in range(4):
        for mode in ("raw", "diag"):
            if mode == "raw":
                Qa, Qb, Ka, Kb = qa[h], qb[h], ka, kb
            else:
                Qa = qna[:,None]*qa[h]*ia
                Qb = qnb[:,None]*qb[h]*ib
                Ka = kna[:,None]*ka*ia
                Kb = knb[:,None]*kb*ib

            curves, bands, contrasts = {}, {}, {}
            for label, S in subspaces.items():
                aa, ba = fourier_coefficients(Qa, Ka, S)
                ab, bb = fourier_coefficients(Qb, Kb, S)
                da, db = ab-aa, bb-ba
                curve = cosine@da + sine@db
                curves[label] = curve
                contrasts[label] = np.array([
                    window_contrast(curve,w) for w in windows
                ])
                energy = da*da + db*db
                total = max(float(energy.sum()),1e-30)
                bands[label] = [
                    float(energy[periods<16].sum()/total),
                    float(energy[(periods>=16)&(periods<64)].sum()/total),
                    float(energy[(periods>=64)&(periods<256)].sum()/total),
                    float(energy[periods>=256].sum()/total),
                ]

            # Difference from non-numerical recency controls.
            specific = contrasts["digits"] - .5*(
                contrasts["letters"]+contrasts["nouns"])
            records.append(dict(
                layer=l, head=h, mode=mode, kind=kind,
                contrasts=contrasts, specific=specific,
                curves=curves, bands=bands
            ))

def sym(M):
    return (M+M.T)*.5

def rotate_difference(K, theta, window):
    _, na, nb, fa, fb = window
    frequency = theta**(-np.arange(0,256,2,dtype=np.float64)/256)
    near = np.arange(na,nb+1,dtype=np.float64)[:,None]*frequency
    far = np.arange(fa,fb+1,dtype=np.float64)[:,None]*frequency
    c = (np.cos(near).mean(axis=0)-np.cos(far).mean(axis=0))[:,None]
    sn = (np.sin(near).mean(axis=0)-np.sin(far).mean(axis=0))[:,None]
    # Mean R(-distance) near minus far, applied only to WEIGHT rows.
    return np.concatenate((c*K[:128]+sn*K[128:],
                           -sn*K[:128]+c*K[128:]),axis=0)

def positive_negative(M):
    vals,U = np.linalg.eigh(sym(M))
    positive = (U*np.maximum(vals,0)[None,:])@U.T
    negative = (U*np.maximum(-vals,0)[None,:])@U.T
    return vals,positive,negative

print("with the recency-update eigendirections. These are weight-matrix controls only.")
rng=np.random.default_rng(92871)

rot*=np.where(np.diagonal(tri,axis1=1,axis2=2)>=0,1.0,-1.0)[:,None,:]

for key in [(15,3),(16,2),(17,1)]:

        R=r["R"]-np.eye(9)*np.trace(r["R"])/9
        D=r["DT"]-np.eye(9)*np.trace(r["DT"])/9
        observed=float(np.sum(R*D))
        rotated=rot@D@np.swapaxes(rot,1,2)
        null=np.einsum("ij,nij->n",R,rotated)
        z=(observed-float(null.mean()))/max(float(null.std()),1e-30)

A, B, tok = Checkpoint("A"), Checkpoint("B"), Tokenizer()
E = A.get("model.embed_tokens.weight")
Ec = E-E.mean(axis=0)
ecnorm = np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(Ec,axis=1),1e-12)

def proto(words):
    ids=[]
    for w in words:
        ii=tok.encode(w)
        if len(ii)==1 and ii[0] not in ids:
            ids.append(ii[0])
    X=Ec[ids].astype(np.float64)
    X/=np.linalg.norm(X,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    return X.mean(axis=0)

other=proto([" know"," say"," want"," need"," have"," see"])
belief=proto([" think"," believe"," guess"," suppose"," reckon"," assume"])-other
calculation=proto([" calculate"," compute"," add"," subtract"," multiply"," divide"])-other
belief/=np.linalg.norm(belief)
calculation/=np.linalg.norm(calculation)

ids=[tok.encode(s)[0] for s in "0123456789"]
Z=E[ids].astype(np.float64)
Z/=np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1,keepdims=True)
Z-=Z.mean(axis=0)
_,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(Z,full_matrices=False)
Qd=vt[s>s[0]*1e-7].T
denom=float(np.sum(Z*Z))

def rownorm(W):
    return np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(W,axis=1),1e-30)

records=[]
print("=== NEW HYPOTHESIS: DIRECT BELIEF-GATING NUMERICAL WEIGHT MOTIFS ===")
print("Eligibility uses MIDPOINT weights: both up and down numerical-subspace fractions >= .05.")
print("Gate alignment, up/down coorientation, and their changes are inspected separately.")
print("No GELU or gate response is evaluated; no gate response is multiplied by an up response.")
print(" L  eligible  DU_positive  max_gate_belief_cos  max_gate_calculation_cos")

for l in range(18):
    p=f"model.layers.{l}."
    ga=A.get(p+"mlp.gate_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    gb=B.get(p+"mlp.gate_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ua=A.get(p+"mlp.up_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    ub=B.get(p+"mlp.up_proj.weight").astype(np.float64)
    da=A.get(p+"mlp.down_proj.weight").T.astype(np.float64)
    db=B.get(p+"mlp.down_proj.weight").T.astype(np.float64)
    gm,um,dm=(ga+gb)*.5,(ua+ub)*.5,(da+db)*.5
    un,dn=rownorm(um),rownorm(dm)
    uf=np.sum((um@Qd)**2,axis=1)/(un*un)
    df=np.sum((dm@Qd)**2,axis=1)/(dn*dn)
    eligible=(uf>=.05)&(df>=.05)
    js=np.flatnonzero(eligible)

    # Numerical up/down outer-product alignment, with gate entirely omitted.
    ra=(ua@Z.T); rb=(ub@Z.T)
    wa=(da@Z.T); wb=(db@Z.T)
    ca=np.sum(ra*wa,axis=1)/denom
    cb=np.sum(rb*wb,axis=1)/denom
    cm=(ca+cb)*.5

    ga_norm,gb_norm,gm_norm=rownorm(ga),rownorm(gb),rownorm(gm)
    gbel=(gm@belief)/gm_norm
    gcalc=(gm@calculation)/gm_norm
    dbel=(gb@belief)/gb_norm-(ga@belief)/ga_norm
    dcalc=(gb@calculation)/gb_norm-(ga@calculation)/ga_norm

    # Scaling control: learned pre-MLP diagonal only, never state normalization.
    ia=1+A.get(p+"pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    ib=1+B.get(p+"pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight")
    gas,gbs=ga*ia,gb*ib
    dbel_scaled=(gbs@belief)/rownorm(gbs)-(gas@belief)/rownorm(gas)
    dcalc_scaled=(gbs@calculation)/rownorm(gbs)-(gas@calculation)/rownorm(gas)
    gbel_scaled=(((gas+gbs)*.5)@belief)/rownorm((gas+gbs)*.5)

    print(f"{l:2d} {len(js):9d} {np.sum(cm[js]>0):12d} "
          f"{np.max(gbel[js]) if len(js) else np.nan:21.5f} "
          f"{np.max(gcalc[js]) if len(js) else np.nan:26.5f}")

    for j in js:
        records.append(dict(
            layer=l,unit=int(j),up_fraction=float(uf[j]),down_fraction=float(df[j]),
            gate_belief=float(gbel[j]),gate_calculation=float(gcalc[j]),
            gate_belief_scaled=float(gbel_scaled[j]),
            delta_gate_belief=float(dbel[j]),
            delta_gate_calculation=float(dcalc[j]),
            delta_gate_belief_scaled=float(dbel_scaled[j]),
            delta_gate_calculation_scaled=float(dcalc_scaled[j]),
            du=float(cm[j]),delta_du=float(cb[j]-ca[j])
        ))
